meta.name: onboarding
meta.description: Guides a first-time omo user through setup and the core workflow. Use when a new user asks to get started with omo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 完成首次设置,跑通核心流程。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚拿到 omo,不知道第一步该做什么。
copy.tagline_en: Finish first-time setup and run through the core workflow.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just got omo and don't know the first step.

howto.what: 它把首次对话变成一段引导：按顺序走功能导览、迁移帮助、会话考古、价值映射、记忆记录和首次会话的 init-deep 提议，其中三项可选，你拒绝就直接跳过。全程用你的语言回复，并把你透露的持久信息写进记忆。
howto.when: 当新用户要求开始使用 omo 时触发；它只在首次自动启动一次，之后可用 `senpi --onboard` 手动调起，或用 `omo-senpi-onboarding-disabled` 关闭自动启动。

say.text: 我是第一次用 omo，带我上手吧
say.note: 启动引导，按顺序走六个环节

say.text: 我原来用 Claude Code，帮我把配置迁过来
say.note: 进入迁移帮助，先给方案等你确认

say.text: 可以看看我以前那些编码会话吗？
say.note: 进入会话考古，据此估算缓存能省多少

howto.what_en: It turns the first conversation into a guided flow: feature tour, migration help, session archaeology, value mapping, memory recording, and a first-session init-deep proposal. It replies in your language, and durable facts go to memory.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a new user asks to get started with omo. It auto-starts only once; users can re-run it with `senpi --onboard` or turn auto-start off with `omo-senpi-onboarding-disabled`.

say_en.text: I'm new to omo — walk me through getting started
I came from Claude Code; can you migrate my setup?
say_en.note: Enters migration help; shows a plan and waits for your OK

say_en.text: Can you look through my previous coding-agent sessions?
say_en.note: Enters session archaeology; feeds the savings estimate
